classes.FACT_MISSING: An approved source holds the fact and DISI does not yet.
classes.HUMAN_REVIEW: The facts are on record and more than one interpretation is defensible; a person decides.
classes.IDENTITY_BLOCKED: The player cannot be researched safely until the identity is resolved.
classes.NOT_A_GAP: The detector read a known structural condition as missing evidence.
classes.SOURCE_LIMITED: No approved readable source holds the fact. Not a research failure, and not evidence that the fact does not exist.
classes.TAXONOMY_GAP: The evidence exists, but the reviewed level taxonomy cannot place it; a future architecture decision is needed.
classes.TRANSACTION_BLOCKED: The chronology depends on a transaction DISI has not recorded; a team change is never a transaction.
